assumptions: W2.3 phase 2 is sqlite-backend-only; file backend behavior unchanged
HEAD-sha comparison is a sufficient re-ingest trigger; manual edits to records/ without a git op are out of scope (startup ingest catches them)
No new user-facing config keys needed (probe TTL is a constant); no plugin changes, so no plugin version bump or token-budget impact
context: W2.3 phase 2 started on claude/w23-phase2-live-ingest. First commit: FOUNDATION-PLAN.md status section reconciling plan doc to shipped reality (W0–W2.3p1 done, phase 2 in progress, W3 next).
rationale: that module is the housekeeping deleted-branch sweep with a different trigger (housekeeping runs) and signal (branch deletion); grafting HEAD-movement detection onto it would couple two unrelated lifecycles.
summary: Chose a new sync-manager module reusing branch-watcher's snapshot-and-diff pattern instead of literally extending src/engine/branch-watcher.ts
